scope: First multi-weight family drawn from the approved 0.400 Regular. 32 styles: weights 100, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, each upright and 10° Oblique, for LihuiT and zayJu. Human visual approval of the new masters is still required before publication.
